altar.definition: The table in Christian churches where communion is given.

aisle.definition: Passageway between seating areas as in an auditorium or passenger vehicle or between areas of shelves of goods as in stores.

vows.definition: A solemn pledge (to oneself or to another or to a deity) to do something or to behave in a certain manner.

rings.definition: Jewelry consisting of a circlet of precious metal (often set with jewels) worn on the finger.

officiant.definition: A person authorized to lead a wedding ceremony.

unity-candle.definition: A ceremonial candle used in some weddings to symbolize two people or families joining together.
unity-candle.exampleUsage: The ceremony included a unity candle as a symbolic tradition.

reading.definition: A passage read aloud as part of a ceremony.

blessing.definition: Words or an act asking for divine favor or expressing good wishes.

kiss.definition: An act of touching someone with the lips as an expression of affection or greeting.

recessional.definition: The procession in which participants leave at the end of a ceremony.

wedding-dress.definition: A dress worn by a person getting married, traditionally associated with a wedding ceremony.
wedding-dress.exampleUsage: The costume exhibition displayed a wedding dress.

veil.definition: A light fabric covering worn over a bride's head or face.

suit.definition: A set of garments (usually including a jacket and trousers or skirt) for outerwear all of the same fabric and color.

tuxedo.definition: A formal evening suit, typically with a jacket and matching trousers.

bow-tie.definition: Neckwear tied or shaped into two loops like a bow.

bouquet.definition: Flowers arranged together, often to be held or given.

boutonniere.definition: A flower that is worn in a buttonhole.

tiara.definition: A jeweled headdress worn by women on formal occasions.

cufflinks.definition: Jewelry consisting of one of a pair of linked buttons used to fasten the cuffs of a shirt.

shoes.definition: Coverings worn on the feet to protect them while walking.

cake.definition: A sweet baked food that may be decorated or filled.

first-dance.definition: A ceremonial dance performed by the newly married couple at some wedding receptions.
first-dance.exampleUsage: The reception schedule listed the first dance after dinner.

toast.definition: A short speech of good wishes, often followed by raising a drink.

dj.definition: A person who announces and plays popular recorded music.

band.definition: A group of musicians who perform together in this reception context.

centerpiece.definition: A decorative arrangement placed in the middle of a table.

table-setting.definition: The deliberate placement of plates, cutlery, glasses, napkins, and decorative items on a dining table before a meal.

dance-floor.definition: An open area intended for people to dance on.
dance-floor.exampleUsage: Guests gathered around the dance floor.

photo-booth.definition: A small enclosed space where people take photographs.

sparkler.definition: A small handheld firework that gives off bright sparks.

bride.definition: A woman who is getting married or has just married.

groom.definition: A man who is getting married or has just married.

bridesmaid.definition: A woman or girl who supports the bride before and during a wedding.

groomsman.definition: A male attendant of the bridegroom at a wedding.

flower-girl.definition: A child who takes part in some wedding ceremonies, traditionally walking before the bride and sometimes carrying or scattering petals.
flower-girl.exampleUsage: The flower girl carried a small basket.

ring-bearer.definition: A child or attendant who carries the wedding rings or symbolic ring holder during some ceremonies.
ring-bearer.exampleUsage: The ring bearer walked down the aisle with a small ring box.

best-man.definition: A person chosen to support one member of a marrying couple, traditionally the groom, during a wedding.
best-man.exampleUsage: The best man helped coordinate the wedding party.

maid-of-honor.definition: A principal attendant who supports one member of a marrying couple, traditionally the bride, during a wedding.
maid-of-honor.exampleUsage: The maid of honor helped organize the bridal party.

guest.definition: A person invited to a wedding.

photographer.definition: A person who takes photographs, professionally or as an activity.

flowers.definition: The colorful parts of plants, often given as a gift.

candles.definition: Stick of wax with a wick in the middle.

arch.definition: A curved decorative structure above or around a ceremony space in this wedding context.

banner.definition: A long piece of fabric or paper displaying words or images.

balloon.definition: A flexible bag filled with air or gas for decoration.

ribbon.definition: A long narrow strip of fabric used for decoration or tying.

fairy-lights.definition: Strings of small decorative electric lights used for soft or festive lighting.
fairy-lights.exampleUsage: Fairy lights decorated the reception area.

lantern.definition: A lamp or light held inside a protective case, sometimes used decoratively.

confetti.definition: Small pieces or streamers of colored paper that are thrown around on festive occasions (as at a wedding).

table-runner.definition: A long narrow piece of fabric laid along the center of a table for decoration.
table-runner.exampleUsage: A linen table runner decorated each table.

invitation.definition: A request (spoken or written) to participate or be present or take part in something.

rsvp.definition: A request to reply to an invitation and say whether you will attend.
rsvp.arabicTranslation: يرجى الرد لتأكيد الحضور أو الاعتذار

seating-chart.definition: A plan showing the places assigned to people at an event.

menu.definition: A list of food and drink available or planned for a meal.

venue.definition: The scene of any event or action (especially the place of a meeting).

caterer.definition: A person who provides food and service (as for a party).

florist.definition: A person who grows and deals in flowers.

dj-booth.definition: A designated area where a disc jockey controls recorded music and sound equipment.
dj-booth.exampleUsage: The DJ booth was set up near the dance floor.

gift-table.definition: A table designated for guests to place gifts or cards at an event.
gift-table.exampleUsage: A sign marked the gift table near the entrance.

guest-book.definition: A book in which visitors write their names, messages, or wishes at an event.
guest-book.exampleUsage: Guests wrote short messages in the guest book.
